title: Pre-runtime harmonization of the Qwen3-VL-2B accepted anchor
trigger: The preserved 2B accepted fixed-64 artifact uses 12 MMStar requests, whereas the pre-registered sensitivity runner and the preserved 4B anchor use 12 requests per task over all six official tasks.

change.added_runtime_cell: Qwen3-VL-2B target coverage 0.45, using the already frozen accepted policy
change.runtime_protocol: AI2D, MMBench, MMMU, MMStar, OCRBench, RealWorldQA; 12 requests per task; fixed 64 generated tokens; repeat 3; paired end-to-end ratios; 10000 bootstrap resamples

reason: All three 2B runtime-sensitivity points must share the same task mixture and sample count. The original MMStar-only result remains preserved as the main-paper historical artifact but is not placed on the six-task sensitivity curve.
selection_rule: The accepted 2B operating point and all quality results remain unchanged regardless of this harmonized runtime measurement.
post_result_rule: Do not substitute the historical MMStar-only number into the six-task sensitivity curve and do not add any further coverage level after observing runtime.
